items.stem: Which is a condition for a binomial model?
options: the probability of success changes each trial
the trials continue until a success
there are more than two outcomes per trial
a fixed number of independent trials
items.answer: a fixed number of independent trials
items.markingKey: Also two outcomes per trial and constant p.

items.stem: State two conditions needed for the number of heads in 10 throws of a coin to be modelled by a binomial distribution.
items.answer: The throws are independent, and the probability of a head is the same for each throw.

items.stem: Explain why the number of aces in a hand of 5 cards dealt from a pack is not binomially distributed.

Explain why a binomial distribution cannot have mean 4 and variance 5.
